item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.10.0 - Search Button and Chip Set Demos
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.10.0. This release adds a search button to the header along with its own demo page, introduces a dedicated Chip Set demo, and brings a set of fixes to icons, internal links, and the build pipeline.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.9.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.9.0 on May 5, 2026! This update focuses on comprehensive dependency updates and improved developer experience—keeping your enterprise admin template modern, secure, and maintainable.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.8.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.8.0 on March 28, 2026! This update brings AI-friendly documentation, new Chip components, enhanced examples, and comprehensive dependency updates to deliver a more powerful and maintainable enterprise admin template experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.7.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.7.0. This update includes the latest CoreUI PRO components with enhanced Calendar featuring custom cell rendering and quarter selection, new Chip components, and comprehensive dashboard improvements for building sophisticated enterprise admin applications.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.6.0
item.description: We’re excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.6.0 on August 8, 2025! This update introduces the powerful new Autocomplete component, comprehensive dependency updates, and enhanced navigation experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.5.0
item.description: We’re excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.5.0! This update introduces powerful new components, improved tooling, and updated dependencies to keep your admin dashboard modern, accessible, and developer-friendly.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.4.0
item.description: We are proud to announce the official release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.4.0 on February 15, 2025. This update marks a significant step forward in improving performance, modernizing our codebase, and enhancing developer experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.3.0
item.description: We are proud to announce the official release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.3.0 on November 15, 2024. This release represents a significant milestone in our continuous effort to deliver a powerful and feature-rich admin template that fully leverages modern web technologies. With v5.3.0, users can enjoy a range of updates designed to enhance performance, compatibility, and the overall developer experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.0.0
item.description: We’re thrilled to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.0.0, dated March 28, 2024. This version marks a significant milestone in our journey, bringing forth the culmination of numerous enhancements, optimizations, and updates to dependencies that collectively elevate the template’s overall performance and user experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.0.0-rc.1
item.description: We’re proud to announce the release of the CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.0.0-rc.1 on March 23, 2024. This update signifies a comprehensive enhancement across the board, emphasizing our dedication to providing the most efficient, modern, and developer-friendly admin template. From updating scripts to refining the template’s overall responsiveness and layout, v5.0.0-rc.1 is tailored to meet the evolving needs of today’s web developers.
